page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at top, page number 340 at top left. Catchword "REPE-" at lower right.

main_text.l: naturalis obligationis, ubi non est ea
participatio, ibi non interire, sed mane
quid enim, quæso, est, quod in huiusce
parte Marcus heres est, pro ea parte
qua ex parte frater, pater've, fratris, f-
ilive peculiū non participauit, pro ea
parte illis suam manere, etiam in suum
Quum igitur Marcus etiā post patris
mortem, pro ea parte qua heres est,
suumq; peculium uti heres posside t,
re partem illam soluti naturalis debiti

page.notes: The running head is in heavy decorative type and I could not read it reliably. The printed "s" (long s) is rendered as plain s throughout. The word "posside t" is printed with a space before the final t and is kept as the printer set it. The small mark at the bottom centre is not text and is left out.
